properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BIP-0038 encrypted private keys: AES-256 in ECB mode (no IV) over the first 16 bytes of the EC key, scrypt-derived key. Mode weakness is locked by the BIP38 wire format. Symmetric — Grover-only, no Shor exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Bitcoin Script OP_SHA1 opcode — consensus-mandated by the Bitcoin protocol (mirrors Bitcoin Core); SHA-1's collisions are irrelevant to consensus but the algorithm cannot be changed here unilaterally.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: java.util.Random / Math.random in production P2P code (ping nonces, peer selection, bloom-filter tweaks) and test fixtures. None of these uses protect secrets — nonces are round-trip matchers — but the weak-PRNG posture is real and recorded (CWE-338).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bitcoinj's entire asymmetric surface: secp256k1 curve constants, ECKey (sign/verify), BIP32 HD derivation arithmetic, BIP38 point multiplication. Every Bitcoin key in every wallet built on this library. Shor-vulnerable; migration is Bitcoin-protocol-governed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The rule fired almost entirely on reference null-guards (11 of 12 sites rejected as false matches). The one real comparison — checkpoint block-hash equals() on public consensus data — stays: non-constant-time byte comparison with no secret-dependent timing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only scrypt cost parameters (N=256) deliberately weakened for test speed; the collector's PBKDF2 label is a mislabel (they are scrypt N values). Production wallet encryption uses N=16384/r=8/p=1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hardcoded key material in test fixtures only: a WIF miner key from a block fixture and BIP32 reference-vector private keys. Test-only, no production exposure, but real key literals (CWE-321 class, test tier).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: GraalVM native-image reflection registration of the JCA DSA key interface in wallettool — platform availability artifact; no application call site for DSA anywhere in the tree. DSA is Shor-vulnerable; it ships but is never invoked by bitcoinj.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: GraalVM reflection registration of the JCA RSA key interface in wallettool — platform availability artifact (transitively pulled in by JDK provider machinery); no RSA call site in the application. Shor-vulnerable for both encryption and signing if ever invoked.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password KDF of the wallet-encryption and BIP38 assets: KeyCrypterScrypt (production N=16384/r=8/p=1, 32-byte salt from SecureRandom) plus the BIP38 variants (N=16384/r=8/p=8 passphrase steps; N=1024/r=1/p=1 intermediate step, spec-fixed). Memory-hard; quantum-irrelevant (no Shor/Grover break of scrypt). Sites span core, wallettemplate app and tests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA512: the BIP32 chain-code MAC and "Bitcoin seed" master-key derivation, the PRF of the custom PBKDF2SHA512, plus the wallettool native-image provider registration. HMAC-SHA512 itself has adequate post-quantum strength; the ECDSA keys it derives remain Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BIP-39 mnemonic-to-seed KDF: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds (spec-mandated), salt "mnemonic"+passphrase — implemented by the hand-rolled PBKDF2SHA512 class. The mnemonic entropy is the real strength; rounds value is fixed by BIP39.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The platform hash of the entire system: Sha256Hash double-SHA256 for transaction/block hashes, Merkle trees, PoW, address hashing (hash160) and BIP32. SHA-256 is Grover-halved only; Bitcoin's PoW and Merkle structure are consensus-locked.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's entropy layer: SecureRandom for EC key generation, HD wallet seeds, AES IVs and scrypt salts; plus the homegrown LinuxSecureRandom provider (reads /dev/urandom, inserted at JCA provider position 1 — a system-wide posture control) and the wallettool Graal registration. 30 of 31 sites confirmed; one logger false match rejected.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped JKS trust store (JCA cacerts copy) inside the bitcoinj core jar — available to consuming applications for TLS trust anchors; no loader exists in this source tree, so its role here is presence/availability only.
